verdict.rationale: Jira claims "Rich APIs", and community users report running REST queries and writing API wrapper scripts to file bugs instead of using the slow UI, so a substantial API clearly exists. Nothing in the pack documents that every UI action is exposed through the API. The 404 OpenAPI probes only show no spec at the guessed paths, which does not contradict the API's existence. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, coverage of configuration, workflow, board and admin operations via API, a discoverable API reference or spec, and independent confirmation of breadth.
